name: resource_group
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk resource group (shared security groups, IAM role, KMS key).

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this resource group.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the resource group.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional description.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs linking this resource group to a cloud provider account. Inherited from the linked network; computed, not user-settable.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Cloud region (e.g. us-east-1).

attributes.name: cloud
attributes.description: Cloud provider the resource group targets. Valid values: Aws, Azure, Gcp, K8S_ONLY. Immutable after creation. Defaults to Aws.

attributes.name: network_id
attributes.description: ID of the network baseline this resource group is linked to. At least one of network_id or vpc_id is required.

attributes.name: vpc_id
attributes.description: VPC ID to associate with this resource group. At least one of vpc_id or network_id is required. The API derives this automatically when network_id is set.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: Environment ID to associate with this resource group.

attributes.name: cluster_id
attributes.description: Cluster ID to associate with this resource group.

attributes.name: aws_resource_name
attributes.description: AWS resource name prefix for provisioned resources.

attributes.name: existing_iam_role_arn
attributes.description: ARN of an existing, customer-managed IAM role for accounts that forbid IAM creation. Used as the resource group's role instead of creating one, together with its four managed policies and instance profile; the role's existing instance profile is looked up and used for EC2 hosts. The role needs the trust and permissions the baseline role would have (e.g. ec2.amazonaws.com, lambda.amazonaws.com, ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com and the platform's deployer principal). With it set, S3 and ECR access grants to this resource group are rejected, since they would edit the role, and namespace IRSA trust is only checked, not added. Leave unset to have the baseline create its own IAM as before. The role is customer-owned: the platform never edits or deletes it. Removing it from the configuration keeps the stored value; setting a different ARN replaces this resource. AWS only.
attributes.patternDescription: must be an IAM role ARN of the form arn:aws:iam::<12-digit-account>:role/<name>, e.g. arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/platform-shared. A path is allowed (role/<path>/<name>); the name is 1-64 characters from letters, digits and + = , . @ _ -. Other AWS partitions (aws-us-gov, aws-cn, ...) are accepted; an IAM ARN never carries a region

attributes.name: existing_kms_key_arn
attributes.description: ARN of an existing, customer-managed KMS key used as the resource group's key instead of creating one and its alias. Every resource that defaults to the resource group key (S3, RDS, ElastiCache, EFS, SNS, SQS, ECR, MSK, EC2 volumes, node groups) then encrypts with it. Must be an enabled symmetric ENCRYPT_DECRYPT key in this resource group's region, because AWS services only use a key in their own region; a multi-region key is supplied by its replica's ARN in this region. Its policy should let the resource group role and the autoscaling service-linked role use the key, and allow EC2 via kms:ViaService for encrypted EBS. Leave unset to have the baseline create its key as before. The key is customer-owned: the platform never edits its policy or schedules its deletion, and KMS access grants from this resource group are rejected. Removing it from the configuration keeps the stored value; setting a different key ARN replaces this resource. AWS only.
attributes.patternDescription: must be a full KMS key ARN of the form arn:aws:kms:<region>:<12-digit-account>:key/<key-id>, e.g. arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab. The key id is a lowercase UUID or a multi-region mrk-<32 hex> id. An alias ARN (:alias/...) is not accepted, because an alias can later be re-pointed at another key

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type: Cli, IacNativeTf, IacDuploTf, or DirectApiCall.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Optional provisioner version.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: User-defined tags inherited by every resource provisioned under this resource group — applied to AWS resources as tags and to Kubernetes objects as labels. Because one map feeds both projections, each entry must be legal as an AWS tag and as a Kubernetes label: keys may carry an optional `prefix/` (a lowercase DNS-1123 subdomain up to 253 characters) followed by a name segment of up to 63 characters, values follow the Kubernetes label grammar, and AWS limits still apply (key up to 128 characters, value up to 256). The reserved `duplocloud.ai/` prefix and the `aws:` prefix are rejected. Removing a key from this map removes the tag from every resource in the group; propagation is asynchronous, so a removed tag can linger on cloud resources briefly after apply. Omit the argument entirely to leave the stored tags untouched; set it to an empty map to remove them all.

attributes.name: metadata
attributes.description: Free-form key/value metadata associated with the resource group. Provide the complete map; on update the full map replaces the previous one. The `delete_protection` key is excluded — it is managed by the delete_protection attribute, and setting it here has no effect.

attributes.name: delete_protection
attributes.description: Guards the resource group against teardown. The platform enables this on every new resource group unless the request says otherwise, and while it is enabled the API refuses both deprovision and delete — so `terraform destroy` fails by design. To tear the group down, set this to false and `terraform apply` first, then destroy. Leave it unset to inherit the platform default (enabled). Stored as the `delete_protection` metadata key.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of this resource group, for reference by dependent resources.

attributes.name: security_group_id
attributes.description: Provisioned main security group ID.

attributes.name: security_group_name
attributes.description: Provisioned main security group name.

attributes.name: alb_security_group_id
attributes.description: Provisioned ALB security group ID.

attributes.name: iam_role_arn
attributes.description: Provisioned IAM role ARN.

attributes.name: iam_role_name
attributes.description: Provisioned IAM role name.

attributes.name: kms_key_arn
attributes.description: Provisioned KMS key ARN.

attributes.name: kms_key_alias
attributes.description: Provisioned KMS key alias.

invalidWhen.message: existing_iam_role_arn is AWS only: it replaces IAM the AWS baseline would create (the resource group role). Remove it, or set cloud = "Aws".
existing_kms_key_arn is AWS only: it replaces the KMS key the AWS baseline would create. Remove it, or set cloud = "Aws".
